RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVE_ID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select dr.drive_id, to_char(dr.drive_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'), substr(InitCap(sp.name), 1,50) Spname from drives dr, drive_sponsors drs, sponsors sp 
where dr.drive_id = drs.drive_id 
and drs.sponsor_id = sp.sponsor_id 
and drive_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.drive_from_date, trunc(sysdate - 30)) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.drive_to_date, sysdate)
and dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
and dr.status = 'CNFRM'
order by drive_date desc

 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;

 into msg
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;

exception

 null; 
end;
